sections.title: Summary
sections.text: Data analyst with 6 years of experience in SQL, Python and A/B testing. Designs experiments and self-serve dashboards that product and operations teams use to make weekly decisions.

entries.title: Data Analyst II
bullets: Co-design and analyze A/B tests on the customer portal with the product team; across 3 tests, a redesigned tracking page raised the self-service rate from 41% to 52%
Analyze 2M+ monthly shipment records in SQL and Python to find where deliveries fall behind, helping cut the late-delivery rate from 9% to 6% in one year
Build self-serve Tableau dashboards used by 35 managers to track on-time delivery across 12 warehouses without waiting on analyst requests
Present weekly findings to operations and product leads; one analysis led to new carrier cutoff times in 4 regions
Mentor 2 junior analysts on SQL and dashboard standards

entries.title: Data Analyst
bullets: Set up automated data quality checks in SQL for shipment reporting, cutting reporting errors by 60%
Rebuilt the weekly carrier performance report in SQL, cutting its run time from 3 hours to 20 minutes
Answered about 40 ad hoc data requests per month from operations, finance and customer support

entries.title: Junior Data Analyst
bullets: Analyzed 18 email and in-store campaigns with the marketing team and found that 2 customer segments drove most repeat purchases
Automated weekly sales reports in Excel for 40 stores, saving the team 6 hours per week
Cleaned and joined point-of-sale and loyalty data covering 250K customers
Moved 12 recurring reports from Excel to Power BI

entries.title: Operations Intern
bullets: Audited patient scheduling data and proposed a shared booking calendar that the front desk adopted to stop double bookings

entries.title: Python, pandas, scikit-learn
bullets: Analyzed 1.2M public bike-share trips to model hourly demand by station; the model predicted next-day demand within 15% for 80% of stations

lines: Relevant Coursework: Econometrics, Statistics, Database Systems
